title: Halo: Campaign Evolved On PC Has A Hidden Feature You Need A Mod To Access
description: This week, PlayStation 5 players were able to join their Xbox and PC counterparts for the first time in Halo: Campaign Evolved. Console gamers are able to use a classic Halo feature that the PC port seemingly lacks: split-screen co-op. However, a new PC mod restores access to this missing feature. A Halo: Campaign Evolved split-screen co-op mod was posted on Nexus Mods by user Jpurd. As noted by Jpurd, the mod doesn't do anything except unlock the local split-screen option that was already in the game. There are some drawbacks to this AI-created mod. It can only handle two players via split-screen mode even though the game can support 4-player co-op. Users also note that it only works if both players are using a controller, and the mod may be limited to Steam users. Anyone playing Campaign Evolved on PC Game Pass or who purchased a copy from the Microsoft Store may not be able to use the mod at all. The rollout of Campaign Evolved hit a snag last week when players who paid extra for early access on Xbox weren't able to jump into the game alongside PC and PS5 ahead of the official launch. Players were also upset about reports that they needed a PS Plus account to use split-screen co-op, but that turned out to not be the case. It's too soon to say how well Halo: Campaign Evolved will perform across all platforms, but the game's secret ending appears to tease a remake of Halo 2 as well. In the meantime, players can use these codes to claim free armor sets in Campaign Evolved.

title: EA CEO Got A Huge Pay Increase While Company Laid Off Devs
description: When Saudi Arabia's leveraged buyout of Electronic Arts is finalized, the newly private company won't have to release any financial documents to the public. In the meantime, EA's latest financial disclosure has revealed that CEO Andrew Wilson received a massive $30 million increase in his compensation this year, and he wasn't the only EA executive to reap the rewards. Per EA's report filed with the Security and Exchange Commission, Wilson's compensation package in the previous fiscal year rose by $8 million to $38 million. That total includes bonus payments and stock options. The report also notes that Wilson's $38 million payout has a 305-1 ratio to the $126,612 annual total compensation received by EA's median employee. Another eye-opening fact uncovered in the report notes that Wilson only flies on private planes rather than commercial airliners. According to the filing, Wilson received this perk to ensue "his personal safety and that of his family based on threat intelligence." No particular threats were shared, but it was noted that Wilson's private flights extended to his personal use as well. The sky-high salaries of other EA execs was also shared, including the following individuals: President of EA Entertainment, Laura Miele -- $13.7 million Chief Financial Officer, Stuart Canfield -- $11.3 million Chief Legal Officer, Jake Schatz -- $8.4 million Chief People Officer, Mala Singh -- $8.3 million Like Wilson's compensation packages, these totals include bonus payments and stock options. The report goes on to tout EA's success in implementing its AI strategy and the financial performance of Battlefield 6 as company highlights. However, EA laid off staff from all four studios under the Battlefield Studios banner earlier this year while characterizing the cuts as a realignment. Miele recently declared that the company's use of AI has led to a " real rise in creativity " among developers who have embraced it. EA's sale to Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund…

title: WoW Classic Hardcore Players Are Being Terrorized By Hidden Underground Enemies
description: World of Warcraft Classic's Hardcore servers are hard enough without having to worry about ambushes from underground, but that's exactly what's happening to unsuspecting low-level players in the game's Stonetalon Mountains zone. The recent patch 1.15.9 introduced various quality-of-life updates to WoW Classic, including improvements to raid frames, nameplates, and even the introduction of the modern game's UI edit mode. Unfortunately, as detailed by players on Reddit and a PSA on Wowhead, it seems the patch also introduced a bug that is teleporting enemies from other Kalimdor zones underneath one spot in particular in Stonetalon Mountains. For normal WoW Classic players, that's not too much of an issue. But on WoW Classic's permadeath server, a group of dozens of high-level enemies hiding underground in the zone's Boulderslide Ravine area is a deathtrap. There are a handful of Horde quests that take players through the area, meaning any hardcore player on their leveling journey through the zone will likely walk right by this potentially character-ending situation. While players can't exactly strike the foes from underground, the mobs seem more than capable of assassinating unsuspecting players, as shown in a clip from Reddit user Party-Signature-8700 where they narrowly avoid dying to a high-level crocodile enemy from an entirely different zone, Dustwallow Marsh. In the video, another player's dead body can be seen nearby, confirming that these enemies mean business. What is causing this particular bug is unknown, but players are theorizing that since the Boulderslide Ravine area is the 0, 0, 0 coordinates for the continent, the game is for whatever reason mistakenly teleporting enemies to that specific location. This can sometimes happen to players as well, such as when disconnecting while on a flight path on another part of the continent, only to find themselves in Stonetalon Mountains at this particular location when logging back in. Blizzard is no doubt aware…

title: Shrek Comes To Ubisoft’s Popular Fighting Game
description: After Shrek was added to a popular soccer game, everyone's favorite green ogre is now in Ubisoft's fighting game Brawlhalla. Shrek is popping up all over the place this year to help celebrate the 25th anniversary of the 2001 film that won the first-ever Academy Award for Best Animated Feature. The Brawlhalla x Shrek event runs through August 19 and also brings Fiona and Puss in Boots to the fighting game; Donkey is available as a companion. As you can see in the trailer below, each character has their own unique fighting style and items. Shrek can bash foes with his "Beware of Ogre" sign, while Fiona keeps it simple and wrecks people with her fists and feet. Puss, meanwhile, uses his sword and lance to bring the pain. Donkey, for his part, reacts to events on the battlefield, and he looks like a great cheerleader. In addition to the characters, the Brawlhalla x Shrek event brings new maps to the game: Shrek's Swamp and Shrek's Muddy Swamp. There are also other items people can buy with real money, including a KO effect of Mongo the giant gingerbread man and Lord Farquaad, Dragon, and Pinocchio emoji skins. The original Shrek movie returned to theaters earlier this year to mark the franchise's 25th anniversary. The long-awaited fifth movie, Shrek 5, is set for release in Summer 2027. The Shrek movie franchise is a juggernaut, with its four main installments collectively grossing $3 billion, and that does not even count the Puss in the Boots spin-offs. In addition to Shrek 5, DreamWorks is producing a Donkey movie for 2028, with Eddie Murphy coming back to voice Donkey once again. Beyond the movies, there are Shrek-themed attractions at Universal Studios theme parks, including the new kids-themed resort in Texas, while many fantastic Shrek memes have helped to keep Shrek popular and relevant for the past 25 years.

title: Jumanji: Open World Trailer Embraces Respawns, Boss Fights, And Everything Else That Makes Games Fun
description: Jumanji is rolling the dice for one last adventure, and ahead of its release later this year, you can check out the new trailer for the upcoming film. Once again featuring the familiar quartet of Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart, Karen Gillian, and Jack Black as the film series' video game avatars--who have somehow escaped into the real world and are acting like TikTok IRL NPCs--Jumanji: Open World is the final chapter in the trilogy that includes 2017's Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle and 2019's Jumanji: The Next Level. "Our heroes have escaped the perilous jungles of Jumanji before, but this time Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world," the official synopsis for the movie reads. Alongside the primary cast--who pull double-duty by switching personalities once they're back in the game--Jumanji: Open World also stars Alex Wolff, Madison Iseman, Morgan Turner, Ser’Darius Blain, Rhys Darby, Nick Jonas, and Danny DeVito. The previous two films have been blockbusters, grossing a combined $1.7 billion at the global box office--and we all know how Johnson is in dire need of a hit movie following a string of high-profile flops like 2022's Black Adam and the live-action version of Moana, where he reprised his role as the egotistical demigod Maui. Jumanji: Open World officially hits US theaters on December 25. The film was initially scheduled to arrive a little sooner, but the one-two punch of Dune: Part 3 and Avengers: Doomsday saw those plans change. It's a good time to be a fan of movies inspired by video games, as two more will arrive before the new Jumanji does. Zach Cregger's brutally bloody reimagining of Resident Evil is out first in September, and it'll be followed by Street Fighter in October. 50 Video Game Movies In The Works: How Many Of Them Will Actually Come Out? title: Naruto Card Game First Look: Rules, Gameplay, And Cards Explained
description: Trading card games are bigger than ever, and anime studios have taken notice. Following the launch of the popular One Piece TCG, the next big IP stepping into the scene is Naruto, the fan-favorite series that helped popularize anime throughout the 2000s. Naruto Card Game launches in Summer 2027, and ahead of its arrival, more details on it have been revealed at Gen Con 2026. What is Naruto Card Game? Described as a strategic trading card game that features characters from the three Naruto series--Naruto, Naruto: Shippuden, and Boruto: Naruto Next Generations--the game features unique mechanics and original designs. If you never read the original manga or watched the anime series, then you've missed out on one of the all-time greatest stories ever told. Naruto tells the story of its titular character, a loud and brash orphan raised in a ninja village who desires to ascend to the highest rank of those warriors, the Hokage, so that he can finally be noticed. Born during an attack by the kaiju-sized nine-tailed fox that almost wiped out the village, the beast was sealed inside Naruto, and he subsequently spent the rest of his life being shunned by his village. Throughout the series, Naruto eventually grows as a ninja and a person, earning the respect of his village, while an overarching narrative throughout the manga and anime sees shadowy forces working behind the scenes. Throw in a few revenge plots, amazing battles that prioritize cunning over brute force, and a ninja world war, and you can see why Naruto is so beloved.. How to play Naruto Card Game Naruto Card Game has each player build a deck of 51 cards, and each deck is centered around a "Leader" card. Support cards include Character, Chakra, Summon, and EX Character cards, and the overall goal is to reduce the Leader's life points to zero. Here's a quick breakdown of how each card works: Leader Card -- The main card that a deck is built around, as a player's cards and strategies are determined by the card color…

title: Resident Evil Movie Is Most Violent Thing Zach Cregger Has Ever Made — “You Gotta Go Grotesque”
description: Zach Cregger is known for gore galore with his horror/thriller movies Weapons and Barbarian, but his new Resident Evil movie is "definitely the most violent" thing he's ever made. He told this to Empire, saying, "You gotta go grotesque" and "all the way" in terms of violence. "So it's gnarly. It's brutal. A very bloody affair," he said. Beyond his directorial projects, Cregger appeared in countless sketches during his comedy days with Whitest Kids 'U Know, and some of them were very violent. In "Sniper Business," Cregger's character witnesses an intern getting shot through the eye with a sniper rifle. In the "Gallon of PCP" sketch, Cregger plays a character whose girlfriend only very recently got beheaded by a drug dealer. Also in the interview, Cregger once again mentioned how he never sought out to make a Resident Evil movie that fleshed out more of the Resident Evil lore or explain in more detail how the T-virus works. "This movie is about one dude's journey on foot, fighting monsters. I don't give a f**k about checking boxes," he said. "All I cared about was just telling a fun story. [One in which] we step on the gas at about eight minutes in and never take our foot off the floor." The Resident Evil movie releases on September 18. It stars Austin Abrams as Bryan, a medical courier who is sent to a hospital in Raccoon City. According to Cregger, Abrams was very nearly killed by a 150-pound blood bag while filming a scene that made it into the final cut. For more, check out GameSpot’s breakdown of the latest terrifying new trailer for the Resident Evil movie. As for the Resident Evil game series, Capcom recently announced that the newest entry, Resident Evil Requiem, has now sold more than 8 million units.

title: Nexus Mods Wants To Replace Modding Frustration With One-Click Simplicity
description: One of the best--and worst--things about PC gaming is the support for mods, allowing users to customize their games to an absurd degree. Installing a mod isn't always straightforward, and the more it remixes a game, the greater the chance of that title crashing, burning, and frustrating the user on the other end. Nexus Mods, one of the largest sites in the modding community, is aiming to fix that issue with a long-term plan to make mods easier to access and use. Following a change in leadership last year that saw Victor "Foledinho" Folmann take over, the current boss of the site has penned an open letter describing plans to change the very nature of how mods are presented, shared, and accessed on the longrunning site. Imagine a future where replacing batarangs in Batman: Arkham Knight with cans of Dr. Pepper is easier than ever. "For going on 25 years now, this platform has been modeling mods as files. Mods are not files. Mods are systems. With dependencies, with conflicts, with load orders, with versioning, with environments, all that complexity," Folmann wrote. "Everything that has been making you angry over the years can be attributed to one factor: the platform models your mods as files. That changes. A platform that knows modding as systems. Where the difficult parts are done for you: dependency resolution, setup validation, and change deployment, making modding more reliable and easier to maintain for everyone." Folmann added that Nexus Mods will be aiming to make mods more accessible to users through a site that will be transformed into a platform for this kind of content, not just a storage hub for the files. Folmann is well aware of the challenges involved, and he added that he wants Nexus Mods to be "Spotify-easy" to use while also serving the community with "GitHub-powerful" toolsets. The site already offers the Vortex tools that creators say make it easier to install and maintain mods, and it's likely that Nexus Mods will expand on this software in the…

title: The Simpsons Return To Fortnite This Week With John Wick
description: The Simpsons are returning to Fortnite with new and improved content on July 30, but this time Springfield will be featured as a Reload map. Epic Games has confirmed some of the new and returning content, including the Simpson's version of John Wick and a new Sprite. Last year's Fortnite x The Simpsons crossover event was a massive success for Epic Games, delivering an explorable, cel-shaded version of Springfield. The map's return in Fortnite Reload will also bring back several fan-favorite loot items, including the Mr. Blasty gun, Krusty Burger, Blinky Fish, Super Squishee, and the Cartoon Chainsaw. With this being the Reload version of Springfield, the map will also feature re-lootable chests and the ability to reboot as solo players. The Tactical Assault Rifle is included as a new weapon for the event. Fortnite x Simpsons Reload event details Homer and Moe the bartender are featured on the promo art for Fortnite Reload, and they're joined by the Fortnite version of John Wick, who will also have a Sprite available to find on the map. Keeping with the John Wick theme, Springfield will also add Wick's The Confidential Simpson's location as a new area to explore on the map. A Spiderman Brand New Day Fortnite collaboration will also arrive soon, including new movie-themed skins and the return of Web-Shooters. Currently, Fortnite is celebrating a DC Comics-themed event with Hot Bat Summer, featuring swimsuit versions of Catwoman, Batman, Harley Quinn, and Poison Ivy.

title: This X-Files-Inspired Detective Game Wants You To Solve Mysteries From Every Angle
description: Mystery games have started to become popular again over the last couple of years, but one studio is aiming to put a new spin on the genre with The Eventide. Billed as a supernatural mystery that follows a team of paranormal investigators through a stylized Canadian neon-noir cityscape, players will have to monitor and study strange cases that have escaped the public eye. The twist here? A "perspective-driven" approach to solving strange cases straight out of The X-Files, as you'll have to use human resources to help crack these mysteries. The debut game from Studio Reset--a developer comprised of people who previously worked on Mass Effect, Dragon Age, and The Long Dark--the Parallax Deduction system drives players to assign the right investigators to each case. Depending on who you task to work the investigation, the outcome might vary wildly. Each agent brings their own background, beliefs, expertise, and way of seeing the world, and these factors will influence how the final case report comes together. The roster of detectives will grow as you progress, and some of the agents revealed so far include a cryptozoologist who takes a grounded approach to exploring the supernatural, a former detective who can read people, and a secretive observer who can perceive latent psychic and emotional energies. One agent can tap into the arcane to uncover clues, another uses science to find answers, and each one has a unique perspective. "We see the world as we need to; not as it is," Studio Reset's creative director Kaelin Lavallee said in a press release. "With The Eventide, we wanted to build a mystery game where solving a case is not just about finding clues. It is about experiencing the cases through the characters' perspective to understand what those clues mean." Another unique aspect of The Eventide is its world, as the studio describes the weird city that players will explore as stylish, strange, and deeply unsettled. title: Double Fine Cuts 25% Of Staff After Separating From Microsoft
description: After regaining its independence from Microsoft, the veteran, esteemed game developer Double Fine has enacted a sweeping round of layoffs. Studio head Tim Schafer said the San Francisco-based studio laid off 23 people this week, which, according to reporter Jason Schreier, amounted to about 25% of the developer's total headcount. "As a small, tightly knit team, these actions are not taken lightly," Schafer said. "Only the survival of our studio would ever make us consider such a painful move." He added that the cuts were directly related to Double Fine regaining its independence from Microsoft. Schafer said Double Fine needed to scale down to become a "size that we can sustain." Every affected staffer will be supported "as best we can," Schafer said. "We thank them for their hard work and commitment to the creative spirit we cherish here at Double Fine." Founded in 2000, Double Fine was an independent studio until Microsoft bought the company in 2019. Schafer told Game Informer in 2019 that he was "very concerned" about selling to Microsoft due to a fear that the company might not be able to retain its "culture and identity" under a behemoth like Microsoft. However, Schafer said he took the deal because he was under the assumption that Double Fine would be "left alone" to "do their own thing and stay independent." Earlier this month, Microsoft announced a drastic "reset" of the Xbox business under Xbox CEO Asha Sharma, and this included Microsoft divesting of five studios, including Double Fine. As part of the separation, Microsoft said Double Fine would retain its IP, catalog, and runway for their next games. Double Fine released three games under Xbox, including Psychonauts 2 (2021), Keeper (2025), and Kiln (2026).

title: Rockstar Co-Founder And GTA Co-Creator On Physical Games: Companies Should Provide It If People Want It
description: Dan Houser, the co-founder of Rockstar Games and co-creator of the GTA franchise, has commented on the ongoing discussion and debate about physical games in the wake of Sony's decision to stop supporting discs in 2028. Speaking to IGN, Houser said, "I don't know that I care." But he said, "If people want that, I think companies should provide it." "But I don't know that I personally care," he said. He went on to say that one of the benefits of digital games is "the ability to update and fix problems," and this has been "really useful for the quality of games." A scene from GTA 6. Houser left Rockstar in 2020. His brother, Sam Houser, remains at Rockstar ahead of GTA 6's release in November. Dan Houser now works at Absurd Ventures with another former Rockstar veteran, Lazlow Jones. Jones said in the IGN interview that he understands how good it can feel to pop a disc into a console, but he also appreciates being able to, for example, download a game at the airport and then play it on a flight. Dan Houser, meanwhile, added, "I love physical media." Absurd Ventures is working on multiple open-world, action-adventure video game projects. One takes place in the sci-fi world of the company's A Better Paradise comic series, and the other takes place inside the studio's comedy satire world, Absurdaverse. Sony is no longer going to support physical game discs on PlayStation starting in January 2028. The company said it's doing this due to "shifting trends in consumer preference." Experts believe the real reason is that Sony can make more money and have more control with an all-digital future. The biggest game of 2026, GTA 6, will be a digital-exclusive. Rockstar will sell a boxed copy of GTA 6 at retail, but people are only getting a code in the box.

title: New GTA 6 Info Coming Soon, It Seems
description: According to a reputable insider, new information about Rockstar's GTA 6 could arrive very soon. NateTheHate, who has accurately reported unannounced details about upcoming games before, recently said he expects to see "a fair bit" of GTA 6 in August. He went on to push back against the narrative that just because Rockstar has not marketed GTA 6 much so far, with just a few months to go before launch, that there is some cause for concern. "They have a marketing plan & they are sticking to that plan. No reason for concern," he said, adding that the game is not delayed and will launch on time on November 19. GTA 6 could get new info soon. Some kind of new reveal for GTA 6 in August makes sense. After all, that's when Rockstar's parent company, Take-Two, will release its next earnings report. The report is set to be released on August 7, and, in a break from tradition, it'll be released on a Friday and before the market opens that day, not after. It's also due time for GTA 6's marketing campaign to begin, considering Take-Two previously said marketing would kick off in summer. GTA 6 preorders opened on June 25. The game costs $80 for the standard edition and $100 for a premium version that includes a bunch of extras. While it's been more than a year since the game's last trailer, Rockstar has released plenty of new screenshots in the time since. GTA 6 is coming to PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar is reportedly testing the game for Switch 2.
